projects.title: Customer Complaints Analysis in Power BI
projects.summary: This interactive Customer Complaints dashboard analyzes complaint trends to highlight service performance and risk areas, helping stakeholders understand what is happening and how effectively issues are being resolved.

samples.summary: This demonstration sample turns a family-style, multi-cuisine restaurant concept into a complete operating and growth plan. It covers market opportunity, customer segments, menu positioning, service operations, marketing, and financial forecasts. It demonstrates how a hospitality idea can be prepared for practical decision-making and funding conversations.
key_deliverables: Menu positioning, operations, and marketing plan
samples.work_demonstrates: How a food-service concept can be translated into an operational and financially grounded business plan.
samples.title: XYZ Restaurant

samples.summary: This confidentiality-safe sample was developed for a client in the Turks and Caicos Islands. It shows how market demand, customer segments, operational capacity, and funding requirements can be brought together in a financing-ready seafood business plan. It demonstrates research, commercial planning, operational strategy, and financial modelling.
samples.work_demonstrates: How research, operations planning, and funding requirements can be connected in a practical seafood business plan.
samples.title: ABC Fishing Company

samples.summary: This confidentiality-safe sample presents a restaurant concept designed for the Turks and Caicos market. It brings together customer research, local-cuisine positioning, site and operations planning, marketing, staffing, and financial forecasts. It demonstrates how a hospitality idea can be shaped into a practical, investor-ready plan.
samples.work_demonstrates: How market context, guest experience, operations, and financial planning can shape a hospitality concept.
samples.title: Blue Hills Restaurant

samples.summary: This confidentiality-safe sample develops a two-villa vacation-rental concept for the Turks and Caicos Islands. It defines the guest segments, property offer, market position, operating model, marketing strategy, and financial plan needed to move the development from concept to funding discussion. It demonstrates end-to-end property and hospitality planning.
key_deliverables: Property offer, operations, and marketing strategy
samples.work_demonstrates: How a vacation-rental concept can be structured for market entry, operations, and investment discussion.
samples.title: Marina Villa TCI

samples.summary: This public sample sets out a two-phase sustainable housing development in the Caribbean for long-term renters and first-time homeowners. It connects housing needs, property mix, sustainability features, site planning, delivery strategy, and multi-year financial forecasts. It demonstrates how a complex real-estate proposal can be organised for financing and execution.
key_deliverables: Multi-year financial forecasts and funding plan
samples.work_demonstrates: How housing need, development delivery, sustainability, and financial planning can be brought into one proposal.
samples.title: SRDL

samples.summary: This demonstration sample develops a regulated indoor cannabis cultivation venture in Massachusetts. It joins licensing and compliance considerations with cultivation operations, target-market analysis, go-to-market planning, and multi-year financial forecasts. It demonstrates planning for a complex, regulation-led market.
samples.work_demonstrates: How regulation, operations, market strategy, and financial planning can be addressed together in an emerging sector.
samples.title: XYZ Cannabis

samples.summary: This public sample outlines a mobile-first fintech concept for lower-cost cross-border payments between Africa and its diaspora. It brings together user research, remittance-market analysis, product architecture, security, growth strategy, and funding forecasts. It demonstrates strategic planning for a technology-led financial service.
samples.work_demonstrates: How customer needs, product strategy, operational readiness, and finance can be aligned for a fintech venture.
samples.title: XYZ Fintech
